title: Brake caliper drift
message: Left front brake caliper may be sticking. Generating excess heat that is transferring into the tyre.
recommendation: Reduce braking T1 and T4. Rear bias up two clicks. Monitor two laps, box if no improvement.

title: ERS harvest decline
message: Harvest 1.9 MJ, below the 5.0 MJ floor. Brake later into the heavy zones.

title: ERS state of charge decay
message: State of charge is declining faster than the deployment model predicts across the last four laps.
recommendation: Switch to balanced deploy through S2 and rebuild charge before the pit window.

title: Brake temp check
message: Brakes 532° front, 299° rear. In window.

title: Rear axle temperature divergence
message: Rear axle running hotter than the traction model expects for this fuel load and track temp.
recommendation: Short shift out of T6 and T9. Protect the rears for the next three laps.

title: ERS harvest decline
message: Harvest 2.0 MJ, below the 5.0 MJ floor. Brake later into the heavy zones.

title: Fuel flow instability
message: Fuel flow rate oscillating outside the normal band on throttle application.
recommendation: Smoother throttle pickup out of the slow corners.
